events.title: RTU Open Day 2026
events.description: Explore RTU faculties, meet professors, and learn about study programs. Open to prospective students and their families.

events.title: Spring Career Fair
events.description: Meet top employers from the Baltic region. Over 50 companies including Accenture, Tietoevry, and Evolution offering internships and graduate positions.

events.title: Hackathon: Green Energy Solutions
events.description: 48-hour hackathon focused on sustainable energy. Form teams, build prototypes, and win prizes. Sponsored by Latvenergo.

events.title: Student Council Elections
events.description: Vote for your faculty representatives in the RTU Student Council. Every vote counts!

events.title: Spring Sports Festival
events.description: Annual inter-faculty sports competition. Basketball, volleyball, football, and athletics. Come cheer for your faculty!

events.title: Guest Lecture: AI in Engineering
events.description: Distinguished lecture by Prof. Dr. Michael Chen from MIT on applications of artificial intelligence in modern engineering practices.

events.title: RTU Cultural Night
events.description: Celebrate the cultural diversity of RTU with performances, food, and music from students representing 50+ countries.
